properties.name: airplay.serverName
properties.description: Receiver name shown in the iPhone Screen Mirroring list.

properties.name: airplay.width
properties.description: Requested display width. auto advertises 1920, or 3840 with HEVC. Actual stream dimensions are always detected from the sender.

properties.name: airplay.height
properties.description: Requested display height. auto advertises 1080, or 2160 with HEVC. This is not the phone's physical screen resolution.

properties.name: airplay.fps
properties.description: Maximum requested frame rate. auto advertises 60 for both H.264 and HEVC. Actual sender frame rate is always measured from timestamps.

properties.name: airplay.audioJitterPackets
properties.description: Audio packet reorder window from 1 to 64.

properties.name: airplay.requirePairing
properties.description: Require Pair-Verify before accepting media setup.

properties.name: airplay.hevc
properties.description: Advertise and receive experimental HEVC screen mirroring. Requires the GStreamer player.

properties.name: airplay.networkInterface
properties.description: Network adapter name or IPv4 address for AirPlay discovery. Auto prefers physical adapters and tries other addresses if Bonjour registration fails.

properties.name: player.gstreamer.swing
properties.description: Show the integrated desktop UI while keeping the native GStreamer video sink.

properties.name: player.gstreamer.videoDecoder
properties.description: GStreamer H.264 decoder element or auto. The matching H.265 element is derived when HEVC is enabled.

properties.name: player.gstreamer.gpuAdapter
properties.description: DXGI adapter index for matching per-device D3D11/D3D12 decoder and sink elements, or auto to enumerate and select a capable hardware adapter.

properties.name: player.gstreamer.videoQueueDepth
properties.description: Bounded decrypted access-unit input queue with backpressure, from 1 to 16.

properties.name: player.gstreamer.renderMode
properties.description: Video presentation policy: balanced, quality, or low-latency.
